son_002_watches: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-GuyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="friendly" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">The one who sits at the end of my bed. He doesn't do anything. He just watches.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_044_never_house: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="-15%" volume="medium">It was never the house.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_045_us: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="narration-professional" styledegree="1.02"><prosody rate="-20%" volume="medium">It was us.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
son_003_closer: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-GuyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.32"><prosody rate="+0%" volume="medium">Mom<break time="420ms"/> he came closer last night. He put his hand on my knee.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_046_third: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.26"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">Tonight is the third night.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_047_lay_down: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.26"><prosody rate="-5%" volume="medium">I put Sam in my bed. Then I walked down the hall, and lay down in his.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_048_blanket: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.26"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">At four o'clock, the blanket moved.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_049_climbed: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.26"><prosody rate="-10%" volume="medium">Something climbed up from the end of the bed. Slowly. Knees. Hands. Closer.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_050_looked: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="terrified" styledegree="1.26"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">This time, I didn't hide. I looked right at it.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
rake_002_lily: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-GuyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="whispering" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-20%" volume="medium">Lily<break time="420ms"/></prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_051_glad: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">Sam. If you're reading this, it took me instead of you. I'm glad.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_052_never_wanted: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">It never wanted children. It visits them three times<break time="420ms"/> and waits to see who loves them enough to lie down in their place.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_053_someone: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-8%" volume="medium">My grandfather did it for my dad. My dad did it for me. Someone always does. Maybe that is what keeps it alive.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_054_starve: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">Maybe if, just once, nobody lay down<break time="420ms"/> it would finally starve.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_055_couldnt: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">I couldn't find out. Not with you.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
narrator_056_decide: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-JennyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="gentle" styledegree="1.08"><prosody rate="-12%" volume="medium">One day, your own child will ask you about the skinny man. And you'll have to decide.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
